notice.window_minimized: The window was minimized to the system tray.
notice.no_pairing_code: No pairing code is currently available.
notice.repair_started: A new pairing process has started.
notice.log_copy_failed: The log could not be copied
pairing.enter_code: Enter this code on the pairing page:
idle.message: Nothing to do – waiting for jobs.
status_code.pairing_expired_new_code: Code expired; creating a new code
status_code.pairing_rejected_new_code: Pairing rejected; creating a new code
settings.title: Settings
settings.local_changes_hint: Changes to the download folder and IRC identity are stored locally and applied immediately while the client is running.
settings.irc_hint: IRC networks, NickServ and SASL are managed in a separate dialog.
settings.irc_separate_hint: Configure IRC networks, NickServ, SASL and your default nick on the separate IRC page. NickServ registration is initiated explicitly there.
irc.title: IRC settings
irc.nickserv_setup_hint: A newly generated nick is not registered automatically. Save it, then use “Register nick now” below. If you already have a registered nick, you can enter its password instead. Downloads will sign in automatically.
irc.auto_register_rules_hint: Abjects and other networks may restrict registration by automated clients. Clicking “Register” does not override network rules; check them first.
irc.reverse_dcc_hint: Only required for bots that use Reverse/Passive DCC. Forward the configured TCP port range through the router and firewall to this client's internal IP address.
irc.local_storage_hint: These IRC settings are stored locally only. Credentials are stored in irc-secrets.json, not client.json.
irc.local_only_hint: Networks and channels are imported from download jobs. Select an existing entry on the left and manage local NickServ and SASL credentials on the right. Leave password fields empty to keep existing credentials unchanged.
irc.no_networks: No IRC networks are available yet. They are added automatically when a download job for a new network arrives.
irc.no_credentials_for_network: No local credentials are stored for this network.
irc.no_credentials: No local IRC credentials are stored. Password fields are intentionally left empty; empty fields do not change existing credentials.
irc.data_privacy: This data is stored locally only and is never sent to autofetch. Passwords are stored in irc-secrets.json, not client.json.
irc.web_networks_hint: Networks are discovered automatically through downloads. Configure one identity per IRC network here; the server provides channels in each job.
irc.reverse_dcc_web_hint: Some bots send files using Reverse DCC. Forward incoming TCP connections in the configured port range through your router to this device's local IP address. The client detects the public IP automatically; AUTOFETCH_DCC_PUBLIC_IP can override it when necessary.
repair.title: Pair client again?
repair.message:
The client will be disconnected from the current account and must then be paired again.

Local settings such as the download folder will be kept.
The server connection will be reset.

Do you want to continue?
web.title: autofetch status
web.irc_auth_required: This download requires a registered IRC nick.
web.irc_auth_instructions: A generated nickname is not registered with NickServ. Register your nickname once according to the IRC network rules (for example in an IRC client), then enter the same nick and password under NickServ. Enable “Use NickServ”, save and retry. If identification fails, check the nick and password.
flag.repair: Start pairing and discard the stored credentials for this client
flag.headless: Run without a graphical interface or system tray
flag.open_browser: Open the local status interface in a browser
flag.no_browser: Do not open the local status interface automatically
flag.webui_addr: Listen address for the local status interface
error.reverse_dcc_port_forward_required: The IRC bot could not reach this client for the Reverse DCC download. Forward the configured TCP port range through the router and firewall to this device.
error.reverse_dcc_port_forward_required_: The IRC bot could not reach this client on TCP port {{.Port}}. Forward the configured Reverse DCC port range through the router and firewall to this device.
error.reverse_dcc_disabled: The bot offered a Reverse DCC download, but Reverse DCC is disabled in the client. Enable it in the IRC settings and configure the required port forwarding.
error.client_not_paired: The client has not been paired yet.
error.client_revoked: The client was revoked or deleted by the server. Pair it again.
error.permission_denied: The client does not have sufficient permission for the selected path.
error.server_unreachable: The autofetch server cannot be reached. Check the network connection and server address.
error.connection_timeout: The connection timed out. Check the network connection and try again.
error.irc_registered_nick_required: This channel requires a NickServ-identified nickname. Open the local IRC settings, use an existing registered nick and enter its NickServ password. “Generate new nick” does not register an account.
error.sasl_auth_failed: SASL authentication with the IRC network failed. Check the username and password.
error.nickserv_identify_failed: NickServ authentication failed. Check the stored password.
error.xdcc_offer_timeout: The XDCC bot did not offer the download within the allowed time.
error.filename_mismatch: The offered filename does not match the expected download.
error.http_404: The download source was not found and can be checked again later.
error.client_shutdown: The download stopped because the client was shut down.
error.pairing_credentials_missing: The server approved pairing but did not return complete client credentials.
error.nickserv_handshake_timeout: Signing in to NickServ took too long.
error.irc_glined: The IRC network blocked this client connection. Check the technical log for details.
error.irc_required_channel_lost: The IRC connection lost a required channel during the DCC download.
error.irc_join_failed: The client could not join the required IRC channel.
error.irc_connection_failed: The connection to the IRC network failed.
error.xdcc_transfer_incomplete: The XDCC transfer ended before the complete file was received.
error.invalid_download_instruction: The download job contains incomplete or invalid information.
error.unsupported_download_mode: This download type is not supported by the installed client version.
error.download_url_missing: The download job does not contain a download URL.
error.download_target_missing: The client could not determine a valid destination filename for the download.
error.http_download_failed_status: The download server responded with HTTP status {{.Status}}.
error.attempt_unavailable: The job is no longer active on the server.
error.server_url_missing: The autofetch server address is missing.
error.config_path_missing: The client configuration path is missing.
error.public_ip_detection_failed: The public IP address required for Reverse DCC could not be determined.
history.retry_confirm: Retry this failed extraction? No new download will be started.
history.local_only: Accessible locally only. Retrying does not create a new download or server lease.
history.remove_confirm: Remove this entry from local history? Technical download receipts will be kept.
history.clear_confirm: Clear visible download history? Files, technical receipts and server jobs will be kept.
history.hide_failed: Could not update local download history.
history.presentation_only: Deleting removes entries only from the local view. Server history, files and technical resume/integrity receipts remain untouched.
activity.title: Activity
webui.password_setup_hint: Optional: Set a password for LAN access here. Leave both fields blank to keep your current password-free access.
webui.password_active: Password protection enabled. Username: autofetch. Password changes from the form are unavailable in this configuration.
webui.password_active_hint: Password protection is enabled. Enter a new password to change it, or leave both fields blank to keep the current password.
webui.leave_unchanged: Leave blank to keep the password unchanged
webui.login_after_save: After saving a new password, your browser will prompt for the username and password on the next request.
webui.password_http_warning: Note: HTTP does not encrypt LAN sign-in traffic. Use only on a trusted network or through an SSH tunnel.
irc.manual_success: NickServ confirmed your sign-in. This nick can now be used.
irc.manual_pending_notice: Request sent. Check for an email confirmation and network instructions, then continue below.
irc.manual_pending: Registration not yet confirmed. Downloads using this nick remain paused until confirmation.
irc.manual_active: NickServ credentials saved. Downloads will sign in automatically.
irc.manual_rules: This sends a NickServ registration command. Only use it where permitted by the network. A verified TLS connection is required. Some networks require email or other confirmation. If a minimum connection age is required, the IRC connection is kept open and this action can take longer.
irc.manual_ack: I have reviewed the IRC network rules and explicitly request this one registration.
irc.manual_link: If you received an activation link, open it first and leave the code empty.
irc.manual_retry_hint: Only if NickServ confirmed that this nick is not registered: retry registration explicitly with the same nick and saved password. No new credentials will be generated. If the network requires a waiting period, this request will keep the connection open; do not reload the page while waiting.
irc.manual_required: This nickname must be registered with NickServ before downloads can use it.
irc.manual_unregistered_notice: Nick enabled without registration. Restricted channels may still reject it.
irc.manual_unregistered_hint: No NickServ on this network and channels are public? You may explicitly use the nick without registration. Restricted channels may reject it.
error.irc_registration_pending: NickServ registration is not complete. Open the local IRC WebUI to confirm the registration, or explicitly allow an unregistered nickname where the network permits it.
irc.job_channels_hint: For reference only: these channels came from earlier download jobs or older local settings. Each new job supplies its required channels.
irc.job_channels_empty: No channels observed from download jobs yet.
irc.setup_intro_simple: Downloads normally need only one nickname per IRC network. The server determines which channels are required.
irc.choose_nick_hint: Enter a nickname or generate a random one, then save it. Generating a nickname does not register it with NickServ.
irc.existing_credentials_heading: Use an existing registered nick or SASL
irc.existing_credentials_hint: If you already have a NickServ account, enter its password here and enable NickServ. No new registration is needed.
irc.nick_change_pending_warning: Warning: Choosing a different nickname discards the pending registration state and its saved password.
irc.save_first_hint: Choose and save a nickname above before registering with NickServ.
irc.pending_next_hint: Registration has already started. If you received a code or activation link, confirm it. You can also check the status without a code.
irc.pending_missing_credentials: The pending registration has no saved credentials. Reset it under “Registration problems?” below, then restart with the same nickname.
irc.reset_warning: Resetting deletes the stored NickServ password for this attempt. Use only if you need to start registration over.
irc.setup_done_hint: No further steps needed. Future downloads will sign in automatically with this nick.
irc.credentials_present_hint: Credentials exist for this nick. Check whether NickServ is enabled under advanced settings.
irc.register_new_intro: If a channel requires NickServ registration, register the saved nick here once. autofetch generates and stores the password automatically. Public channels do not require this.
irc.registration_email_hint: Enter an email address you can access for NickServ registration. It can differ from your autofetch account email; some networks require verification.
irc.live_intro: Live IRC network feedback (without credentials). Registration may require a waiting period. Keep this page open until the action finishes.
irc.live_connecting: Connecting securely to the IRC network …
irc.live_waiting: NickServ requires waiting on the same connection.
irc.live_retry: Sent the request again with the same nickname and password.
irc.live_error: Action failed. Existing credentials remain saved.
irc.live_connection_error: The local WebUI connection was interrupted. Reload the setup page and check status before registering again.
irc.live_warning: Messages are filtered and do not contain the passwords, email addresses or confirmation codes you entered.
irc.desktop.save_tls_nick: Set a nickname and TLS server first.
irc.desktop.ack_short: I have reviewed the network rules
irc.desktop.acknowledge: I reviewed the network rules and explicitly request this registration.
irc.desktop.progress_empty: IRC responses will appear here during the action.
irc.desktop.identity_changed: The network identity changed. Reopen settings.
irc.desktop.pending_no_password: Registration pending, but no saved password was found. Reset the pending registration to start over.
irc.desktop.status_identified: NickServ configured. Future downloads sign in automatically.
irc.desktop.status_not_registered: Not registered. Usually unnecessary for public channels.
irc.desktop.reset_warning: Reset only the pending local registration? The nickname is preserved.
irc.desktop.explanation: A nickname is enough for public channels. Register with NickServ only if the network requires it.
irc.desktop.network_email_hint: Optional for public channels. Used only for NickServ on this network.
irc.desktop.title: NickServ registration
